acceptance_criteria: Thresholds below, equal to, and above the default produce identical enforcement, health, startup-notice, and console/API state.
Health carries configured/effective maxRestarts and does not derive tripped from an unrelated default.
Missing first run, valid state, invalid shape, corrupt JSON, oversized state, non-private permissions, unreadable file, write failure, durability-unproven write, and verified recovery are distinct.
Invalid or unavailable state can never serialize as ordinary healthy zeros without availability metadata.
An unknown previous exit cannot become clean and cannot silently authorize proactive replay.
Service startup and inbound traffic remain available under guard-store failure while automatic replay follows the declared fail-safe policy.
Invalid state is preserved or quarantined and reset disposition is metadata-only.
A successful write cannot clear degradation until a fresh read verifies the published generation.
Future timestamps, backward clock steps, counter overflow, duplicate boot timestamps, window changes, threshold changes, and configuration reload or restart are fault-injected.
Startup notice, logs, runtime health, fleet health, and console agree on decision, threshold, availability, and observation time.

Exact-byte tests prove no location, raw error, stack, checkpoint/session/chat identifier, message, user/host/account identity, credential, process value, or private topology reaches shared diagnostics.
blast_radius: Agent restart admission, proactive checkpoint replay, restart-loop state persistence and recovery, startup notification truth, runtime and top-level health, fleet line projection, console diagnosis, and privacy of shared recovery diagnostics.

falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding is falsified if the decision and health paths consume one resolved policy, invalid or unavailable storage remains distinguishable from first-run state through mutation and recovery, unknown prior exit cannot authorize automatic replay, and recovery requires verified readback. The exact-main call graph and isolated threshold and malformed-state canaries disproved those conditions. This review did not build the full clock, permission, atomic-write, restart, API, console, and privacy fault matrix; the 24 green existing tests establish current behavior rather than the required cross-surface contract.
impact: A configured threshold can suppress proactive recovery while health says the guard is not tripped. Missing and failed state are indistinguishable from an idle healthy guard, and an unproven boot-marker write can be treated as a clean prior exit, allowing repeated automatic replay without a truthful availability or recovery signal.

suggested_remediation: Resolve one immutable restart-loop policy object and thread it through decision, stored state, startup notice, runtime health, fleet API, and console. Replace nullable load/save semantics with bounded typed outcomes and a tri-state prior-exit result; preserve service admission but require an explicit policy for automatic replay when protection state is unknown. Preserve or quarantine invalid state, publish generation and availability metadata, and declare recovery only after fresh readback verifies the new generation. Register bounded causes through #2447 and add the complete threshold, storage, clock, restart, projection, and privacy matrix.
